description: This file defines the interface for media frame writing, including the factory class for creating frame writers and the IMediaFrameWriter interface itself. It includes method declarations for writing media segments and retrieving the number of written frames, and references external classes and types related to media pipeline and shared memory.

classes.name: IMediaFrameWriterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaFrameWriter instances, providing a method to obtain the factory and to create frame writers.

classes.name: IMediaFrameWriter
classes.description: Interface for writing media frames to shared memory, including methods to write frames and get the count of written frames.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the singleton instance of the IMediaFrameWriterFactory.

methods.name: createFrameWriter
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaFrameWriter object given a shared memory buffer and info.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment to shared memory.

methods.name: getNumFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames written so far.
